# SPA sample files

Thermo OMNIC SPA files from two CC-BY-4.0 records, copied unchanged.
Decision 0006 (`docs/decisions/0006-phase-5-data-sources.md`) names both.

## `ecoflex-1.SPA`, `ecoflex-1.CSV`, `Eco (1-1) - 1.SPA` — CC-BY-4.0

From **FTIR test for MXene-Based Ecoflex Dry Electrodes (TextrodeMisc Project
Dataset)** by Xi Wang, Zenodo (2025),
<https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17691644>, licensed **CC-BY-4.0**
(<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>). `ecoflex-1.CSV` is the
instrument's own export of `ecoflex-1.SPA` (7468 points, 4000 to 400 cm-1, %T)
and is what the reader is checked against. `Eco (1-1) - 1.SPA` is in
absorbance, which is what the mixed-unit refusal needs.

## `dust/` — CC-BY-4.0

`hac6_ref.SPA`, `hac6_0_0e0.SPA` and `hac6_1_0e12.SPA`, from **Heavy-ion
irradiation of interstellar carbonaceous/siliceous composite dust analogs.
cosmic rays - grain interactions at the nanometer scale** by Eddy Abdo, Zenodo
(2026), <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21396092>, licensed **CC-BY-4.0**
(<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>). A second instrument: 29868
points each, on one shared axis, read as one dataset from a zip.
